## Appearance

Barney Pullen is a large, overweight young man with a wide, freckle-covered round face. His facial appearance is typically devoid of expression.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

Barney Pullen is a large, emotionless individual known for his expressionless face and a severe inability to engage in chatter, laughter, or general conversation. Despite his timid and bashful nature, he possesses good sense, works extremely hard, and is recognized as a reliable person without negative vices.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 ch.Proposal P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 ch.Proposal P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022)_

## History

Barney Pullen helped escort [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde to a charity concert at the [Pale Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel), waiting outside while they attended the event. After his father bestowed the upper farm upon him under his own name, Barney sought to take a bride and sent his sister, [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md), to propose marriage to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on his behalf. Following Nell's firm refusal of the proposal, Barney went on to marry [Nettie Scobie](../character/nettie-scobie.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P33](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0033), [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 ch.Proposal P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016), +7 more_

## Relationships

### [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barney-pullen--odette-pullen.md)

Barney is Odette's brother, and the two travel together to local events, such as bringing [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde to a charity concert at the [Pale Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel). [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) acts as an intermediary for her bashful brother, going so far as to propose marriage to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on Barney's behalf on New Year's Eve. When [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rejects the proposal, [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) casually notes that Barney will likely marry [Nettie Scobie](../character/nettie-scobie.md) instead, shortly before [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) herself plans to move West.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), +13 more_

- Sibling of — brother  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P27](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0027), [v3 ch.Proposal P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), +1 more</sub>

### [Nettie Scobie](../character/nettie-scobie.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barney-pullen--nettie-scobie.md)

Nettie becomes Barney's wife by the time [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley). Prior to their marriage, [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) predicted that Barney would marry Nettie after [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rejected a marriage proposal made on his behalf.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
